NOTE: retrievedDate moved BACK to 2026-05-07 when the earnings-test exempt amounts joined this file — a file is only as fresh as its stalest source, and ssa-earnings-test was last pulled in May. The figures themselves were confirmed 2026-08-07 against the archived snapshot, which is weaker than a re-pull and is why the date was not bumped instead. 2026-08-08 — family-maximum bend points ($1,643 / $2,371 / $3,093 for 2026 eligibility) read from POMS RS 00605.910, which secure.ssa.gov serves to an automated client even though www.ssa.gov does not. These are a DIFFERENT set from bendFirst/bendSecond above, which are the PIA formula's bend points over AIME — confusing the two is the obvious way to get the family maximum silently wrong, which is why they sit in the same object with distinct names.
